faqs.q: How does SiteFlow keep the budget in sync with the BOQ?
faqs.a: Each budget line maps to a BOQ item or cost category. As procurement, site store issues, attendance, and subcontractor RA bills are recorded, actuals post against those lines so committed and spent amounts stay current.

faqs.q: Can I see cost variance before a project closes?
faqs.a: Yes. Variance is visible by cost category in real time, with under-budget and review-required flags so site and finance teams can act on overruns while there is still room to correct them.
